description: Use it when the person asks about their own booking, hold or enquiry. Pass ref for one, or nothing for all of theirs, newest first. It needs the person signed in and answers only what is theirs: the status, the yacht, the days, how long a hold lasts, and what is paid and outstanding.

ref.description: A booking or enquiry reference. Leave it out for everything the person has.

One booking or enquiry: ref, kind, item, days, party, status, statusLabel, holdUntil, supplier, price, paid, outstanding, nextStep.
